{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS261 |prevtitle=It All Ends Now II |nextcode=PS263 |nexttitle=It All Ends Now IV |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=It All Ends Now III |subtitle=My Bubble Gum |title_ja=最終超決戦III |title_ro=The Final Battle III |image=PS262.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 262 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|22}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 262 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|22}} |location=[[Sootopolis City]] }} '''It All Ends Now III''' (Japanese: '''最終超決戦III''' ''The Final Battle III''), titled '''The Final Showdown III''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 262nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 82nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''My Bubble Gum''' (Japanese: '''届け　フーセンガム''' ''Go and Report, Bubblegum'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Go To Him, Bubble Balloon''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Courtney]] tries to tell {{adv|Ruby}} that his father, {{adv|Norman}}, had arrived on top of {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}. The collective roars of {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}, {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} and {{p|Rayquaza}} drowns out Courtney's voice, which prevents Ruby from hearing her. Courtney tries to pull Ruby close and tell him, but a tentacle shoots out of the [[Cave of Origin]] and drags her inside. Ruby and [[Mumu]] go inside the shrine to try and save her. A three-way attack from Groudon, Kyogre, and Rayquaza causes a huge explosion, which breaks apart the Cave of Origin. Ruby has Mumu try and move the debris, but Courtney tells Ruby to stop, as she can no longer move her legs. Courtney forces the [[Blue Orb]] out of her body and rolls it near Ruby. Courtney tells Ruby to face Kyogre and Groudon alone, as it's the end of the line for her. Ruby refuses and reveals that he wants to compete in a [[Pokémon Contest]] with her. When Courtney asks how he knew that she did Contests, Ruby remembers that when she burned a [[Ribbon]] back at [[Rusturf Tunnel]], it couldn't possibly be his. Courtney flashes back to when she was younger and did Contests with [[Daisy Oak]], which she guesses is why she has some affection for Ruby. Courtney tries to tell Ruby about his father again, but the debris blocks her voice from reaching him. Instead, Courtney blows a bubble and covers it with {{b|Lansat}} and [[Starf Berry]] juice to increase the buoyancy and strength. She attaches her Memory Lighter to the bubble and sends it to Ruby. The battle between the three Pokémon causes more debris to fall, killing Courtney in the process, much to Ruby's horror. Courtney's bubble balloon floats towards Ruby, who catches it. Ruby uses the light on a piece of paper, which comes out as an image of the {{badge|Balance}}. Ruby remembers Courtney's words, and notices that his father is standing on top of Rayquaza's head. As Courtney lies dying, she tells Ruby to bear witness to what she learned at the [[Mossdeep Space Center]]. ==Major events== * [[Courtney]] tries to tell {{adv|Ruby}} that the person controlling {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}} is {{adv|Norman}}. * A tentacle pulls Courtney inside the [[Cave of Origin]]. * The Cave of Origin collapses, with Courtney inside. * Courtney's past is revealed. * A dying Courtney reveals to Ruby everything she knows. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Norman}} * [[Daisy Oak]] (flashback) * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Swampert}} ([[Mumu]]/{{tt|Zuzu|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Clefairy}} ([[Daisy Oak]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Tentacruel}} ([[Archie]]'s) * {{p|Vulpix}} ([[Courtney]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Kyogre}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre|Adventures}}) * {{p|Groudon}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon|Adventures}}) * {{p|Rayquaza}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza|Adventures}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|最終決戰III|The Final Battle III}} (Taiwan)
